title: NLnet open call (Restack, CodeSupply and other funds)
description: NLnet grants for technical development of free and open source software, hardware and content, through its themed funds (Restack for the open internet stack, the CodeSupply pilot for software supply chain security) or its open call. First grants run EUR 5,000 to EUR 50,000. Proposals are collected per deadline; the next is January 3, 2027.
reward: EUR 5,000 to EUR 50,000 for a first grant
summary: EUR 5,000 to 50,000 · next deadline Jan 3, 12:00 CET

eligibility.note: software released under an open licence, using open standards where possible

opens_note: Submissions are paused after the last deadline; the next deadline is January 3, 2027 at 12:00 CET
setup: request a security code by email from NLnet
each_time: a budget breakdown with tasks, effort and rate
rules: Proposals are collected per deadline. The page states it is currently not possible to submit; the next deadline is January 3, 2027 at 12:00 CET (noon). Deadlines fall on the 3rd of every odd month.
First grants are between EUR 5,000 and EUR 50,000.
Grants are primarily for technical development. Software, hardware and content must be released under open licences and use (preferably open) standards.
Proposals should be made by humans, not AI. Answer in plain text, in English and in your own words. If you used generative AI, say so and submit your prompts and the AI output with the proposal.
EU-supported funds need a strong European dimension: usually applicants should be mostly from Horizon Europe-eligible countries.

Restack funds the open internet stack (core internet infrastructure, alternatives to closed technologies, secure and privacy-friendly devices); AI-related projects are not in scope there, with one exception.
CodeSupply is a pilot for open source software supply chain security, cybersecurity data and license compliance.
Submitting needs a security code, requested by email from NLnet.
